about.title: MADE FOR THE DISTRICT
about.lede: DISTRICT WEAR started with a simple idea: clothes for the street, made with the care usually reserved for something far less everyday.
about.manifesto: We believe streetwear should be built to live in, not just to be photographed. Every cut is considered, every fabric chosen for how it wears, washes and holds its shape. No seasonal noise, no disposable details — just pieces that earn their place in your rotation.
about.principleOneCopy: We start with the material and let the construction follow. Weight, drape and feel decide what a piece becomes.
about.principleTwoCopy: Silhouettes that work on real bodies and in real streets. Nothing decorative that gets in the way of wearing it.
about.principleThreeCopy: Small runs, careful finishing and details that survive the wash. We would rather make fewer, better pieces.
about.cityCopy: Everything begins in Casablanca — in the workshops, on the streets, in the city that keeps us honest. Craft here is close enough to touch: we work with people who make things properly, and we keep our runs small enough to care about every single piece.
